Definition: probably from the base of G3735; right (as rising), i.e. (perpendicularly) erect (figuratively, honest), or (horizontally) level or direct:--straight, upright.
BiblicalUsage: Upright means straight, rising, level. Jesus told the man with the withered hand to stand upright on his feet, and Hebrews says to make straight paths for your feet, lest that which is lame be turned out of the way.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe straight paths are the ones that heal: when my feet are upright, the lame are lifted rather than turned aside.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
